row: Hetherington Therapy is a company/family that provides Pediatric Occupational, Physical, and speech therapy services in the homecare setting.  This channel is designed to help a therapist with Tips & Tricks within the Pediatric population, whether for the seasoned Pediatric therapist, a college student, or a current therapist transitioning into the pediatric world!  Our other focus for the channel is to provide education to families/parents with children with specific extra needs.   This will give them more knowledge of what to look for in a therapist and what the therapist will be working on with the families.  Lastly it will give a look into the world of a therapist in the pediatric world on a daily basis and what is expected in this lifestyle of therapy in the home, in the school and out in the community!  So please sit back and enjoy and by all means help spread the word!!
